d: 🌟 We're Hiring: AI Tools Trainer / ChatGPT Prompt Specialist

We are a business-focused organization embracing digital innovation and practical AI solutions to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and support smarter business operations. We believe that effective AI adoption starts with the right knowledge, practical training, and responsible use of technology.
We are seeking an enthusiastic and knowledgeable AI Tools Trainer / ChatGPT Prompt Specialist to deliver practical training and guidance on ChatGPT, generative AI platforms, and prompt engineering.

In this part-time, fully remote role, you will help individuals and business teams understand how to use AI tools effectively, develop high-quality prompts, and apply AI capabilities to everyday professional tasks. The ideal candidate combines hands-on AI experience with strong communication and teaching skills.
Deliver engaging online training sessions covering ChatGPT and other relevant AI tools.
Teach prompt engineering techniques, including prompt structure, refinement, and optimization.
Develop practical training materials, presentations, demonstrations, and learning exercises.
Guide learners in using AI for content creation, research, summarization, brainstorming, and business communication.
Demonstrate AI applications for administrative, marketing, customer service, and operational workflows.
Explain how to improve AI-generated outputs through clear instructions, context, and iterative prompting.
Introduce learners to relevant generative AI platforms and productivity tools.
Demonstrate practical AI-assisted workflows that improve efficiency and reduce repetitive tasks.
Explain AI limitations, output verification, data privacy, and responsible usage practices.
Assess learner progress and provide constructive feedback and recommendations.
Stay updated on new AI tools, platform features, and developments in prompt engineering.
Support the development of AI adoption guidelines and practical learning resources.
Minimum 3+ years of relevant professional experience in AI applications, digital training, technology, business support, or a related field preferred.
Hands-on experience with ChatGPT and other generative AI platforms.
Strong understanding of prompt engineering and AI-assisted workflow development.
Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and practical way.
Excellent communication, presentation, and instructional skills.
Experience delivering online training, workshops, coaching, or demonstrations is an advantage.
Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and other productivity platforms is beneficial.
Understanding of AI-generated content verification, privacy, and responsible AI practices.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Technology, Business, Education, or a related discipline preferred.
Relevant AI, digital technology, or professional training certifications are advantageous but not mandatory.
Flexible part-time working arrangements with a fully remote setup.
Opportunity to contribute to the growing adoption of practical AI skills.
Exposure to emerging generative AI technologies and innovative business applications.
A collaborative environment that encourages experimentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
Opportunities to develop training expertise while helping others build confidence with AI.
A professional culture that values innovation, practical problem-solving, and digital transformation.
If you are passionate about artificial intelligence, prompt engineering, and helping others use technology more effectively, we welcome your application.
This role involves leading and supervising mechanical maintenance activities for engines and auxiliaries at a power plant, ensuring operational reliability and adherence to HSE standards

True to our motto – ‘Moving big things to zero’ – we help key industries in the global economy to reduce hard-to-abate emissions. Identify main components of the equipment / system
